patthana15.27:1.1: sappaccayaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na appaccayo na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana15.27:2.1: sappaccayaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na appaccayo na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana15.27:3.1: sappaccayaṃ abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na appaccayo na abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ. saṅkhataṃ sappaccayasadisaṃ. sanidassanaduka kusalattike nasanidassanaduka nakusalattikaṃ
